ink-950.role: dark ground for objects on the light page, page ground in dark mode

aqua-400.role: the mark's light; large shapes and text on ink only, never text on paper

marigold.role: the one action colour; ink label, one primary per screen

green.role: Available now badge only, with icon and words; darkened from #1F9D74 to pass 4.5:1

red.role: errors only; darkened from #D64545 to pass 4.5:1

mist-on-ink.role: the only secondary text on ink, 8.4:1

display.notes: two lines maximum at desktop; 40 px cap keeps the hero headline on two lines at 1280

bangla-heading.role: h1 to h3 on the Bangla route
bangla-heading.notes: line height 1.4 protects matras and descenders; no tracking

shadows.rule: shadows only on things that float or emit light; the page itself is flat with hairlines

motion.assembly: 1.5s expo.out, stagger 45ms random, scroll-scrubbed over 70 percent of a viewport on desktop, on enter on phones, once per session
motion.line-drawing: stroke-dashoffset scrubbed from 85 percent to 50 percent viewport
motion.reduced-motion: every animation collapses to its end state
motion.rule: one authored motion moment per section; transform and opacity only; no scroll listeners

extensions.darkMode: html[data-theme=dark] remaps --bg, --bg-alt, --fg, --fg-muted, --line, --accent, --accent-strong, --tile, --tile-line, --card onto the ink and aqua ramps; light is the default regardless of OS preference

badge-available.html: Available now, free

narrative.northStar: A light room with one dark screen in it. Numbers as facts. One warm colour that asks.
rules: Only the appointment module is Available now; every other module is Early access in mist.
Marigold appears once per screen, with an ink label.
Aqua is light, not ink: on the mark and on dark grounds, never as text on paper.
No eyebrows, section numbers, scroll cues, gradient text, glows on paper, em dashes.
One motion moment per section, static under reduced motion.
narrative.notCanonized: The variants board (src/pages/variants.astro) and its grid-line background are a working document deleted before launch, not part of the system.
